name: Qutebrowser
author: Maximilian-Maag
description: Qutebrowser as the default Omarchy browser — all 22 stock themes, KeePassXC password fill, ad-free YouTube, and built-in ad blocking.

features: 22 Omarchy themes with automatic switching on omarchy theme set
KeePassXC password fill via qute-keepassxc userscript
Robust KeePassXC fill (qute-keepassxc-fill): multi-step Google/Microsoft/Apple logins, hidden-field safe, TOTP
YouTube ad-free via Greasemonkey script + fetch/XHR interception
Built-in host + Adblock filter-list ad blocker (Brave + EasyList)
AI per-site fixes (qute-ai-fix) applied via generated per-domain Greasemonkey scripts, with a JavaScript over-blocking check
Reader mode (,r): distraction-free article view with paragraph focus, local-AI per-paragraph/whole-article AI-writing marks and a summary
Stock-Chrome identity for bot-managed sites (LinkedIn, Kleinanzeigen, immowelt): a host-scoped Chrome fingerprint so a bot interstitial does not block the page
Sets qutebrowser as the system default browser
